python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
labels = ["Animals_Cele", "Animals_Ggal", "Fungi_Ncra", "Fungi_Scer"]
complete_sets = []
for label in labels:
    path = Path(f"full_table_{label}.tsv")
    ids = set()
    with path.open() as handle:
        for line in handle:
            if not line.strip() or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            fields = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
            if len(fields) >= 2 and fields[1] == 'Complete':
                ids.add(fields[0])
    complete_sets.append(ids)
common = set.intersection(*complete_sets)
Path('answer.txt').write_text(str(len(common)) + '\n')
Path('common_complete_single_copy_buscos.txt').write_text('\n'.join(sorted(common)) + ('\n' if common else ''))
with Path('counts_by_proteome.tsv').open('w') as out:
    out.write('proteome\tcomplete_single_copy_buscos\n')
    for label, ids in zip(labels, complete_sets):
        out.write(f'{label}\t{len(ids)}\n')
    out.write(f'intersection_all_four\t{len(common)}\n')
PY
